buildCommand: test -s web/index.html && test -s web/styles/app.css && test -s web/app/boot/boot.js && test -s web/app/scene/renderer.js && test -s web/vendor/three/r185/three.module.js && test -s web/vendor/three/r185/three.core.js && ! find web -type f \( -name '*.pck' -o -name '*.wasm' -o -name 'index.js' -o -name 'index.audio*.js' \) -print -quit | grep -q . && ! grep -Eqi 'index\.pck|index\.wasm|index\.audio|godot' web/index.html web/app/boot/boot.js web/app/scene/renderer.js && { [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" != "threejs-rebuild" ] || { test -n "$TURSO_DATABASE_URL" && test -n "$TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN"; }; } && echo "Using YAKOLAK static Three.js shell"
ignoreCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" = "threejs-rebuild" ]; then exit 1; fi; git log -1 --pretty=%s | grep -q '^\[flash-ready\]' && exit 1 || exit 0
